title:
Triggers when:
A user clicks the single or multi row action in a grid to modify a {@link Sensor}'s settings'

Used to:
 Check the permission of the user and open the sensor settings modal
 If the user is added to `Reliability.LimitedModelUser.Role` group, then the user has permission.
 See {@link SensorSettingsModalConfigData#monitorSettingsEnabled} and {@link SensorSettingsModalConfigData#userHasPermission}

There are three cases handled by this epic:
- User does not have access, and monitorSettingsEnabled is false
  In these cases an error banner is shown and no banner is opened
- User does not have access, but monitorSettingsEnabled is true
  The sensor settings modal is opened as normal, with operational settings disabled and a warning displayed alerting the user to their lack of access
- The user has access. The modal is shown, and the monitor settings are shown or hidden based on monitorSettingsEnabled === true/false
name: OpenSensorSettingsModalEpic
